name: Voidbound Umbral Tin
tooltip:
Voidbound Umbral Tin
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
Umbral Tin is distinguished from its less impressive cousin by the deep shade of the ore. It resembles the inky black sky. Umbral Tin is more durable yet also more flexible than most other metals.

Adventurers are no strangers to the Void and its adverse effects. Nothing can escape its touch, from dragon aspects to humble ore deposits. Gathering Voidbound ore provokes it, causing the swirling energies to coalesce into a terrifyi- [the entry suddenly cuts off].

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
